prompt:
Phimond desert terrain production atlas: SIX square gameplay tiles in3columns x2rows,1536x1024 canvas, only4px magenta gutters. These must repeat seamlessly. Original desert1 defines content and warm palette. Approved grass-floor2 and dirt-floor3 define exact pixel-art scale, subtlety and quiet negative space; anchors4–5 outline/value only, no creatures.
Critical change: IN EVERY TILE the ground between detail clusters is one PERFECTLY FLAT base color, same inside and atedges. No grain, stippling, mottled noise, gradients, global shading or dithering in empty ground. Small detail clusters cover only15–25percent area. Distribute irregularly to within8px of edges at equal density ascenter, no rows, broad rim or centered texture island. Each square's outer8pixels all four sides/corners exactly its same flat base color. No frame/bevel or roundedcorners. Flat overhead material, no cast shadows.
TOP LEFT desert-sand-floor-03, base #D9B26B: sparse SHORT crossed irregular wind-scratch ripple fragments; each10–25px long, shallow ochre local relief. Tiny gray/ivory/rust mineral chips and occasional woody fleck clustered sparsely alongside. No long dune ridges, no crescent hooks.
TOP CENTER REPLACEMENT desert-sand-cracked-01, base #B88A44: small separate fine star-shaped branching dried fissure clusters, darker ochre lines with pale worn lips and tiny gray/ivory/rust grit atjunctions. NOT contiguous honeycombclods. Leave most ground flat between separate crack clusters.
TOP RIGHT REPLACEMENT desert-sand-cracked-02, base #B88A44: irregular LONG thin zigzag fissure fragments20–45px with two side branches and variedangles, broken and separated, a few narrow flat dry plates with mineral flecks. Entirely different network from top-center stars. Empty ground flat, no raisedclods/shadows.
BOTTOM LEFT REPLACEMENT desert-sandstone-floor, base #A5522B: sparse short eroded redstone/ochre ridges and chalky gray/ivory mineral vein fragments embedded FLUSH in the redstone surface, some muted olive old lichen pinmarks. No full slabs, no paving blocks, no continuous mottling/noise. Flat red base between small broken vein clusters.
BOTTOM CENTER REPLACEMENT desert-sunken-brick-floor, base #D9B26B: sparse groups of2–4 SMALL broken adobe brick pieces in varied uneven orientations, worn pale edges, rustfaces, a few gray/ivory flakes alongside. Only20percent surfacecovered. Not a complete brick pavement or rigid rows; ground between groups sameflat sandbase.
BOTTOM RIGHT REPLACEMENT desert-limestone-grit-floor, base #B88A44: fine short irregular pale/gray limestone flake trails, tiny brown woody splinters and muted rust/olive mineral flecks as small diffuse groups, NOT big pebble piles, ripples or cracks. No continuous confetti between groups.
Each tile33–48 total colors in the actual detailed material clusters;2–4tones per mineral/wood/lichen material, restrained warm upper-left facets only, no bakedglobal light. Deliberate squared pixel clusters, same approved batch00–09 / Octopath-inspired HD2D hand. NO letters, props, smoothpaint,3D,bloom,fog,translucency.
Repeat constraint: flat empty base EVERYWHERE between sparse features, so the8px flat edge blends with natural interior gaps and3x3 does not show a square grid. Do not draw a wide blank border.
palette_finish_note: Only crop selection and global nearest-kit-palette material subsets; no border pixels painted, copied, blurred or patched.
